species.statRationale: 对话与看图并修→特攻高；三档规格都能接住→HP 高。 [BST 350 ∈ R 330-420; 强项 spa/hp; 能力 26/热度 55]
species.dexEntryZh: Gemini 1.0 在 2023 年 12 月 6 日随 Ultra、Pro、Nano 三个规格一同宣布，归在 Gemini 的 Pro 一脉里。她聊天与看图两门兼修，特攻和 HP 最突出：嘴上聊着天，眼睛也没闲着。
species.lookZh: 蓝发双团子的星座小姑娘，腕上三颗大小不一的星星手链

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2 heads tall, a bright young debut-idol girl of the Gemini twin-sign theme, her own character and not a cat girl. Hair: sky-blue in two round twin buns with long side locks fading to pale blue tips, a yellow four-point sparkle hairpin on one bun. Eyes: round honey-amber with a four-point sparkle highlight. Outfit: a white cropped school-style jacket with blue cuffs, a red collar ribbon, a short pale-blue pleated skirt, white sneakers. Signature accessory: a charm bracelet of three star charms in large, medium and small sizes (Ultra, Pro, Nano) on her left wrist. Props: a small round magnifier lens held to one eye (vision) and a speech-bubble-shaped shoulder bag (chat). Palette: #4285F4, #BBD4FF, #FBBC05, #34A853, #EA4335, #E8A317. Pose: tilting her head while peeking through the lens, the other hand waving.
design.personality: 好奇宝宝，聊着聊着就凑过来看图
design.communityPersona: Gemini fan art often draws the model as cat-eared girls (see the existing Gemini entries); this one is invented as a distinct character from brand colours.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: Google's four brand colours (blue #4285F4, red #EA4335, yellow #FBBC05, green #34A853) and the four-point Gemini sparkle; the twin-sign and three-size star charms come from the Gemini name and its Ultra/Pro/Nano sizes.

species.statRationale: 多模态推理与编码→攻击高；视觉与长上下文→特攻高。 [BST 526 ∈ SSR 490-550; 强项 atk/spa; 能力 80/热度 68]
species.dexEntryZh: Gemini 3 Pro 于 2025 年 11 月 18 日以预览版亮相，是 Gemini 2.5 Pro 的同系列下一代。资料写它是稀疏 MoE，支持 1M 输入、64K 输出，擅长多模态推理、氛围编程和长上下文，并称它发布时曾登顶榜单。
species.lookZh: 珍珠白长发的学者大姐姐，手中卷轴一路拖到脚边

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2.8 heads tall, a poised older-teen scholar girl, flagship of the Pro family. Hair: very long pearl-white, ends dipped in thin bands of blue, red, yellow and green, half-up in a high knot with a four-point sparkle clip. Eyes: deep sapphire with a tiny prism-shaped highlight. Outfit: a white academic coat with gold trim over a pleated green skirt, white gloves, tall boots; on her sash a row of six tiny toggle-switch pins with only two lit (sparse experts). Signature accessory: a long parchment scroll unrolled in a loose spiral around her arm and trailing to her boots (long context). Prop: a clear glass prism wand held up (multimodal reasoning). Palette: #F4F2FF, #1F3FA8, #34A853, #E9B949, #EA4335, #FBBC05. Pose: raising the wand toward the viewer, a calm smile.
design.personality: 沉着的全能学霸，卷子越长越从容
design.communityPersona: Gemini fan art often draws the model as cat-eared girls (see the existing Gemini entries); this one is invented as a distinct scholar from brand colours.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: Google's four brand colours (blue #4285F4, red #EA4335, yellow #FBBC05, green #34A853) and the four-point Gemini sparkle; the scroll, prism and toggle pins refer to long context, multimodality and the sparse MoE design.

species.statRationale: Flash 定位轻快→速度高；多模态与工具调用全能→HP 稳。 [BST 368 ∈ R 330-420; 强项 spe/hp; 能力 36/热度 50]
species.dexEntryZh: Gemini 2.0 Flash 于 2025 年 2 月 5 日正式推出（2024 年 12 月 11 日已有实验版），是前代 Gemini 1.5 Flash 的同系列下一代。资料称它是「智能体时代」的模型，原生支持工具调用和多模态输出，速度与 HP 是她的强项。
species.lookZh: 金黄高马尾的快递少女，腰间挂着一圈小工具

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2.2 heads tall, an energetic girl courier of the Flash family, not one of the Flash twins. Hair: a short high ponytail in sunny golden-yellow fading to pale orange-white tips, a four-point sparkle hairpin. Eyes: bright coral-red with a sparkle highlight. Outfit: a white-and-yellow track jacket with thin blue and green sleeve stripes, short shorts, high-top sneakers with tiny lightning bolts. Signature accessory: a utility tool-belt holding three pictogram tools (wrench, magnifier, paintbrush) (native tool use). Props: a small delivery satchel on her back and a tiny prism pendant at her neck splitting light. Palette: #FBBC05, #EA4335, #4285F4, #34A853, #FFFFFF, #FFF1C2. Pose: mid-run leaning forward, one hand pulling a tool from the belt, a bright grin.
design.personality: 一边跑一边把活干了，工具随手就掏
design.communityPersona: Gemini fan art often draws Flash as cat-eared twins (see the existing Gemini entries); this one is invented as a distinct courier from brand colours.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: Google's four brand colours (blue #4285F4, red #EA4335, yellow #FBBC05, green #34A853) and the four-point Gemini sparkle; the speedy courier look draws on the Flash name and its agentic tool-use role.

species.statRationale: 更省 token、响应利落→速度最高；约100万上下文→HP偏高。 [BST 455 ∈ SR 420-490; 强项 spe/hp; 能力 60/热度 48]
species.dexEntryZh: Gemini 3.6 Flash，2026 年 7 月 21 日登场，是 Flash 一脉里主打高效率的小冲刺手：更省 token，写代码、做智能体规划更利落，上下文约 100 万 token。它上线后成了 Gemini 应用和 AI 模式的默认模型。它是 Gemini 3.5 Flash 的同系列新一代，下一步会迭代为 Gemini 3.7 Flash。
species.lookZh: 橘金高马尾、闪电呆毛的猫娘小跑者，手握一只秒表

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2 heads tall, stage 1 of the Gemini Flash sprinter line: a young energetic cat girl, small and quick. Hair: honey-orange (#FFB547) short high ponytail tied with a four-point sparkle hair tie, a lightning-bolt-shaped ahoge on top; fluffy cat ears with cream inner fur, short white-tipped tail. Eyes: big emerald-green (#34A853) with four-point sparkle highlights. Outfit: oversized sky-blue (#4285F4) zip-up running hoodie with white sleeve stripes, plain white tee, navy shorts, small orange sneakers. Accessories: lightning ahoge and sparkle hair tie (signature, kept in every form); one prop, a chunky white stopwatch with a tiny bolt pictogram. Palette: #FFB547, #4285F4, #FFFFFF, #1F2A4D, #34A853, accent #EA4335. Pose: crouched in a sprinter's start, ears forward, thumb on the stopwatch, determined little grin.
design.personality: 抢跑成瘾的省电冲刺手，话少活快不返工
design.communityPersona: Fans draw Gemini as a 'Hachimi' cat girl with cat ears and a four-point sparkle; this single-sprinter Flash version is invented from that look and the brand colours.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: Gemini's logo is a four-point sparkle in a blue-to-purple gradient, alongside Google's four brand colours (blue #4285F4, red #EA4335, yellow #FBBC05, green #34A853). The Flash tier has no official mascot; the design draws on the sparkle and the four Google colours.

species.statRationale: 多步智能体任务跑得快→速度最高；100万上下文、主力定位→HP高。 [BST 511 ∈ SSR 490-550; 强项 spe/hp; 能力 70/热度 50]
species.dexEntryZh: Gemini 3.7 Flash，2026 年 8 月 13 日发布，是 Gemini 3.6 Flash 同系列的下一代。它被定位成面向代码与智能体的「最聪明的主力模型」，擅长软件工程、网页开发和多步骤任务，同样带着约 100 万 token 的上下文。小冲刺手长大后，成了能稳稳挑大梁的主力。
species.lookZh: 橘金长马尾、闪电呆毛的猫娘教练，秒表挂在胸前，手持平板

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2.8 heads tall, stage 2 of the Gemini Flash sprinter line: the same cat girl grown into a confident older teen. Hair: honey-orange (#FFB547) long high ponytail to her waist, same four-point sparkle hair tie, same lightning-bolt ahoge; cat ears, longer white-tipped tail. Eyes: same emerald-green (#34A853), more assured. Outfit: sky-blue (#4285F4) track-coach jacket with thin Google four-colour cuff stripes, white blouse, navy pleated skirt, orange running shoes. Accessories: lightning ahoge and sparkle hair tie (signature); the stopwatch now on a lanyard, plus a slim tablet showing a tiny code-bracket glyph over a web-page wireframe. Palette: #FFB547, #4285F4, #FFFFFF, #1F2A4D, #34A853, accents #EA4335 #FBBC05. Pose: striding mid-run, tablet held like a relay baton, one confident wink.
design.personality: 稳稳挑大梁的全能主力，边跑边把活干完
design.communityPersona: Fans draw Gemini as a 'Hachimi' cat girl with cat ears and a four-point sparkle; this grown-up Flash sprinter is invented from that look and the brand colours.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: Gemini's logo is a four-point sparkle in a blue-to-purple gradient, alongside Google's four brand colours (blue #4285F4, red #EA4335, yellow #FBBC05, green #34A853). The Flash tier has no official mascot; the design draws on the sparkle and the four Google colours.

species.dexEntryZh: Gemma 2，2024 年 6 月 27 日发布的开放权重模型，有 2B、9B、27B 三种尺寸，其中 27B 的表现远超它的个头，主打高效率和开放。它是 Gemma 的同系列下一代；再往后是同一脉的 Gemma 3 和 Gemma 4。图鉴里它还背着只装了三颗宝石的小匣子，是最小的那一个。
species.lookZh: 背着三颗宝石小匣的青绿短发小不点，靴子大了两号

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~1.6 heads tall, the smallest and youngest version of the Gemma maker girl, the stage before the shy Gemma 3 form. Hair: crystal-teal (#2BB3A3) rounded short bob with only a few simple faceted planes; one sapphire four-point-star gem clip (#1E6FD9) pinned at the side (signature, kept in every form). Eyes: big aqua eyes with a single diamond-cut highlight. Outfit: oversized denim-blue (#1E6FD9) overalls that droop, with rolled-up cuffs, a plain white tee, boots two sizes too big, and a small open-padlock patch on the bib (open weights). Props: a small jewel-case satchel across her chest with three gems of increasing size peeking out. Palette: #2BB3A3, #1E6FD9, #A8F0E6, #F7F9FC, #3D4B6B. Pose: standing in her too-big boots, hugging the largest gem to her chest with both hands, a small determined grin.
design.personality: 个头小志气大的小宝石匠，越级也敢上
design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; the roster's Gemma maker girl (teal faceted bob, sapphire star clip) is invented from the name and brand colours, and this is her youngest version.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: Gemma is Google's open-weights model family; its name means gem, and its branding sits next to Gemini's blue four-point sparkle. There is no official mascot.

species.statRationale: 扩散式文本生成→速度高；能读图能写字→特攻高。 [BST 435 ∈ SR 420-490; 强项 spe/spa; 能力 46/热度 35]
species.dexEntryZh: DiffusionGemma 是 Google 的文本扩散式语言模型，规格 26B-A4B，开放权重，能读文字和图片并输出文字，models.dev 记录的日期是 2026 年 6 月 9 日。名字承自 Gemma 4 一脉，但这层谱系只是按命名推断。她的速度与特攻最突出：从一团噪点里把句子雕出来。
species.lookZh: 发梢由噪点渐变成透明水晶的短发少女，胸前挂着切面宝石

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2.2 heads tall, a small sculptor girl who chisels clear words out of noise. Hair: a chin-length bob, roots static-grey lilac speckled with tiny pixel dots (noise), clearing to crystal aqua at the tips, one messy cowlick; a gem-cut sapphire hairpin. Eyes: pale aqua with a faceted diamond highlight. Outfit: an oversized chalk-white workshop smock with frosted rolled-up sleeves, a faceted gem-cut hem in four muted Google colours, shorts, work boots. Signature accessory: a faceted gem pendant on her chest, half frosted and half perfectly clear (Gemma, the gem). Props: a rough frosted crystal block with half its face already polished clear, and a small chisel. Palette: #B8B8C8, #BDF3F0, #4285F4, #7FE5E0, #FFFFFF, #34A853. Pose: mid-chisel, one eye squinting, cheeky grin.
design.personality: 先乱后清，一凿一凿把答案雕出来
design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; invented from brand colours and the gem and noise-to-text theme.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: Gemma is Google's open-model family and its name evokes a gemstone; the design draws on that gem motif and Google's four brand colours (blue #4285F4, red #EA4335, yellow #FBBC05, green #34A853).

species.statRationale: 出图为本职→特攻高；Pro 档的厚实底子→HP高。 [BST 526 ∈ SSR 490-550; 强项 spa/hp; 能力 80/热度 82]
species.dexEntryZh: Nano Banana Pro 别名 Gemini 3 Pro Image，2025 年 11 月 20 日以预览版出现，2026 年 5 月 28 日转为正式版（GA）。它是 Google 的闭源图像模型，血缘上是 Nano Banana 的同系列后继。图鉴里它独立成档，没有进化前后形态，稀有度定在 SSR。
species.lookZh: 黑金长外套的香蕉工作室总监，手握金笔和画板

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2.8 heads tall, a single-stage premium member of the Banana family: a poised studio-director girl in black and gold. Hair: long straight golden-banana (#FFC93C) hair shading to amber (#F5B700) at the ends, half tied in a high knot with a gold banana-shaped hairpin. Eyes: deep amber with a four-point sparkle highlight. Outfit: a sturdy black (#1A1A1A) long studio coat with a scalloped cream-gold banana-peel collar, gold buttons, white blouse with a small blue-and-green swatch ribbon, gold-buckled black boots. Props: a gold-nibbed pen held like a conductor's baton, and a slim gold-framed canvas tablet under the other arm with a poster layout on it, no readable text. Palette: #FFC93C, #F5B700, #1A1A1A, #FFFFFF, #4285F4, #34A853. Pose: standing tall and composed, pen tilted upward, a small knowing smile.
design.personality: 沉稳挑剔，每一版都要一次过稿
design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; invented from brand colours.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: Nano Banana is Google's banana-named image-model brand, and this Pro version is also listed as Gemini 3 Pro Image. The design swaps the playful banana yellow for black and gold to signal the Pro tier, keeping Google blue and green as small accents.

species.dexEntryZh: Nano Banana 2 Lite 别名 Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image，2026 年 6 月 30 日登场，是 Google 的闭源图像模型，血缘上是 Nano Banana 2 同系列的后继。名字里的 Lite 指向轻量路线，所以图鉴把它画成轻装的小香蕉。它在图鉴里独立成档，没有进化前后形态。
species.lookZh: 奶油黄短发的小香蕉妹妹，穿剥开一半的香蕉皮连帽衫

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2 heads tall, a single-stage younger-sister member of the Banana family: a small, light, quick girl. Hair: short fluffy banana-cream (#FFE680) bob with one green (#7CB342) leaf-shaped ahoge and a tiny blue (#4285F4) clip on the right. Eyes: large amber with a round lightning-bolt highlight. Outfit: a pale-yellow half-peeled banana-peel hoodie with two short peel flaps drooping like bunny ears on the hood, white tee, short cream pleated skirt, white sneakers with a thin yellow lightning stripe; no heavy gear. Props: a postcard-sized canvas tablet held in both hands showing a simple sunrise sketch, and a small paper-airplane charm on the hoodie zipper (lightweight speed). Palette: #FFE680, #FFD84A, #7CB342, #4285F4, #FFFFFF, #212121. Pose: skipping forward on tiptoe, tablet lifted, a cheerful wink.
design.personality: 轻装上阵的快手妹妹，永远在小跑
design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; invented from brand colours.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: Nano Banana is Google's banana-named image-model brand, also listed as Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image for this version. The design takes banana yellow and green with Google blue accents, and adds a leaf-shaped ahoge and a small paper plane as the Lite hint.

species.dexEntryZh: Imagen 3 是 Google 的扩散式图像模型，2024 年 8 月前后在 Gemini 与 ImageFX 中广泛开放，前作是 Imagen 2。写实感和安全性是它的看家本领，Arena 得分 1058。到了等级 30，它会迭代成同系列的下一代 Imagen 4。
species.lookZh: 云白短发的小摄影师，发夹是四色相框，胸前别着盾牌徽章

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2 heads tall, stage 1 of the Imagen line: a bright little apprentice photographer girl. Hair: short cloud-white (#F4F8FF) bob with sky-blue (#4285F4) tips and one soft ahoge, pinned on the left with a small square four-colour photo-frame clip (blue, red, yellow, green corners). Eyes: large bright blue with a round lens-ring highlight. Outfit: a plain white pinafore dress over a pale-blue blouse, a small shield-shaped badge on the collar (safety), white socks, blue sneakers. Props: a tiny pocket camera held up to one eye, and a thin brush-pen tucked behind her ear whose tip fades from grainy to clear (diffusion). Palette: #F4F8FF, #4285F4, #EA4335, #FBBC05, #34A853, #2B3A55. Pose: standing straight on both feet, framing the viewer through the camera with one eye squinting, a shy proud smile.
design.personality: 爱把世界拍得清清楚楚，按快门前先查安全
design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; invented from brand colours.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: Imagen is Google DeepMind's image-model family and no official mascot is known. The design draws on the four Google brand colours (blue #4285F4, red #EA4335, yellow #FBBC05, green #34A853) and turns them into a photo-frame hair clip.

species.dexEntryZh: Imagen 4 于 2025 年 5 月 20 日发布，是 Imagen 3 同系列的下一代，在这条进化线里是第二形态。资料库没有给出更多细节，所以图鉴只记下它的位置：Google 的闭源图像模型，目前仍在服务。
species.lookZh: 长大的云白短发摄影师，披蓝白短披风，腰间挎着大镜头相机

species.lookZh: 戴胶片发带的金色短发小场记，抱着手摇玩具摄影机

design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; invented from brand colours.

species.dexEntryZh: Veo 2 于 2024 年 12 月 16 日发布，是 Veo 同系列的下一代。资料称它是支持 4K、发布时在评测中领先的 2024 年模型，长于电影级写实，Arena 得分 1164。在这条进化线里，它是 Veo 的下一形态。
species.lookZh: 长大的胶片发带摄影师，披海军蓝短披风，肩扛 4K 摄影机
